Spread
  1. Push the MG996R into the wrist housing from its open side and screw its tabs.
  2. Put the idler spacer on the housing’s idler bolt. Fit the head yoke: thick plate on the servo horn, thin plate over the spacer.
  3. Fit the LED and heatsink in the seat at the back of the head shell. Wires go out through the cable windows.
  4. Slide the shell’s back sockets 50 mm onto the yoke’s two posts.
  5. Push the SG90 into the pocket on the side pad. Two screws.
  6. Fit the camera pan bracket on the SG90 horn, then the tilt yoke and camera.
  7. Lay the 8 iris blades on the rim pins.
  8. Drop the iris ring on, its pins into the blade slots.
  9. Screw the iris cover on (4 screws).

Load on each servo

Bar: this pose with springs. Grey tick: this pose without springs. Red line: MG996R stall, 9.4 kg·cm at 4.8 V. Keep the bar under about half of that for smooth moves.

ESP32 servo values (PCA9685)

Same numbers your ESP32 code sends. ch1 and ch2 count down from 180: horns fitted at 180 with the upper arm at −50° and the forearm at −10°. ch3 head = 185 − aim − forearm.
